name.ja: HGUC 1/144 BHC専用エコプラ 量産型ザク
name.en: HGUC 1/144 BHC exclusive eco plastic mass production type Zaku

description.ja: ●「機動戦士ガンダム」に登場する機体をエコプラでキット化
description.en: ●The aircraft that appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam" is made into a kit using Ecopla.

description.ja: ●武器はザクマシンガン、ザクバズーカ、ヒートホークが付属
description.en: -Weapons include Zaku Machine Gun, Zaku Bazooka, and Heat Hawk.

description.ja: ●脚部に取り付けるフットミサイルが付属
description.en: -Comes with foot missiles that can be attached to the legs.

description.ja: ●フットミサイルのミサイルは全て別パーツで再現
description.en: -All foot missile missiles are reproduced with separate parts.
